issue.title: [Bug]: Non-vision capability gate fails the turn on marker-shaped prose that references no loadable image

steps: I am writing a test spec for image markers. In the spec, a missing image is written as [IMAGE:/nonexistent/shot.png] and should be kept as plain text. Please summarize in one sentence what that marker means.
expected: Because the marker references no loadable image, the message is treated as text and the agent answers normally.
defect: The turn fails before any model request with `provider_capability_error ... capability=vision message=received 1 image marker(s), but this model_provider does not support vision input`.

fault location.explanation: Returns a hard ProviderCapabilityError whenever the latest user message has any image marker and the model lacks vision; PR #10904 (commit 638d0f6) gates this on count_latest_user_resolvable_image_markers and otherwise degrades to text.
Counts markers on syntax alone (parse_image_markers), without checking that the path exists or the data URI is valid; PR #10904 adds count_latest_user_resolvable_image_markers.
Treats any reference starting with '/', http(s)://, data: or a Windows drive as an attachment, so `/nonexistent/shot.png` qualifies.

Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw/pull/10904 (commit https://github.com/zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw/commit/638d0f63361f223702c1c98900d7afaa753c05a8, "fix(runtime): gate the no-vision error on image markers that resolve"). At the pinned v0.8.5, resolve_vision_provider computes latest_user_image_marker_count with multimodal::count_latest_user_image_markers, which counts every `[IMAGE:...]` marker whose reference passes is_loadable_image_reference — a purely syntactic test (leading '/', http(s)://, data:, drive letter). When the selected model has no vision capability and no vision_model_provider is configured, a non-zero count makes the function return ProviderCapabilityError, so a user message that merely quotes `[IMAGE:/nonexistent/shot.png]` fails the turn before dispatch, while the same text arriving as a tool result is only stripped with a WARN. The fix adds count_latest_user_resolvable_image_markers (existing, policy-allowed files; structurally valid data URIs; remote URLs only when remote fetch is enabled) and uses it for the hard-fail gate, degrading to text-only otherwise. The fix first ships in v0.8.6; the pinned revision does not contain it. Whether the unit's custom slot reports vision=false is not stated in launch.py (round-4).
